agent_assumptions: Interior 2F door heights assumed 2.1m clear (z 3.0-5.1m), no elevation evidence for interior partitions.
South/East/West 2F window heights assumed equal to the North_view-measured 2F window family (sill 4.03m, head 5.86m); not independently pixel-measured on those elevations in this pass.
No exterior doors exist on F2 per plan and elevation evidence (West_view/East_view show only windows on F2); vertical circulation between F1 and F2 is not shown in supplied inputs and is not modeled.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
unresolved: South_view.png and East_view.png 2F window heights not independently pixel-measured; using North-derived family as an explicit assumption.
No stair/vertical-circulation evidence supplied; F1 and F2 are modeled as independent stacked floors without an explicit connection.
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.
